newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: MAS to take delivery of B777 in April.
newsitem.headline: MAS to take delivery of B777 in April.

text.p: Malaysia Airline System Bhd (MAS) will take delivery of its first Boeing B777 aircraft with a Rolls Royce Plc Trent 800 engine next month, the national Bernama news agency said on Tuesday.

It quoted a statement by Rolls Royce's representative office in Singapore as saying the delivery will be the airline's first after placing an order with Rolls Royce 15 months ago for the engine fittings.
MAS said last year that it would take delivery of four Boeing 777-200 passenger jets in 1997 and delivery of about five aircraft a year between 1998 and 2001.
Last year, Malaysia's national carrier announced it was buying 10, 777-200 planes, five 777-300s and 10 747-400s costing 10 billion ringgit from Boeing.
A MAS official told Reuters the B777 delivery was scheduled for the latter part of April but did not have other details. Rolls Royce officials in Singapore were not immediately available for comment.
Bernama said the first B777 for MAS rolled off the line on Tuesday in Seattle.
